name: set_selected_object_animation_at_frame

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_SetSelectedObjectAnimationAtFrame consumes three values, queues operation type 19 with animation_id OR 0x10000 and blend_duration, and stores twice frame in the operation payload

notes: The embedded operation-name table labels type 19 MOTION_PAUSE. Its dispatcher creates the same motion-request record as the normal animation path and overwrites that request's starting-frame field with the encoded frame. The JP corpus contains 71 calls; animations 200 through 205 dominate.
